Q1
What is the single highest-priority workflow/file/script to improve?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan phase - reply with the exact workflow or script name/path (RECOMMENDED)
B. Implement / review / orchestrate / validate phase - reply with the exact workflow or script name/path (RECOMMENDED)
C. Docs / templates / repo metadata - reply with the exact file path/name (RECOMMENDED)
D. Other - reply with the exact file(s), workflow(s), or script(s) to change (RECOMMENDED)
Q2
What concrete improvement do you want in that target?
Choices:
A. Fix incorrect behavior - describe current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reduce reliability / performance / duplicate-run / noisy-log problems - name the symptom and desired improvement (RECOMMENDED)
C. Improve docs / usability / maintainability - describe what is confusing or missing and the desired outcome (RECOMMENDED)
D. Other - describe the before/after behavior in 1-2 sentences (RECOMMENDED)
Q3
What should count as "done" for this issue?
Choices:
A. A specific issue / PR / workflow run / log example is fixed or no longer reproduces (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable target is met (for example fewer retries, timeouts, or duplicate dispatches) (RECOMMENDED)
C. A specific file / text / output changes in a stated way (RECOMMENDED)
D. Other - write the exact acceptance check (RECOMMENDED)
